title: Give each About scene the pure data.ts its clock contract names, and test by import
deviations_from_card: sceneAt returns named flags/stages plus per-row arrays (landed[i], rows[i], voted[i], met[i]); beats.test.ts flattens arrays to name[i] for the totality/complete/first-ness checks. The old stillTick regex test in chapters.test.ts is deleted (superseded by beats.test.ts, which also carries the 'passes stillTick: STILL' source pin via .includes, not regex). statusPicker tables stay in TSX (they need t() with ICU args) but each `satisfies Record<StatusBeat, string>`, tying them to STATUS_BEATS at compile time. Added GATE_LABEL, WINNER and tally() to data.ts so chapter 6's code-label pin and chapter 4's running tally leave the TSX too. Write set grew by perf-budget.json only (shared surface, committed alone under the lock): app/page.tsx's graph needs +6 modules (one per scene, by design) and +11 KB. The chapter 4 detection-constant and chapter 1-3 Python/catalog pins are unchanged.
notes: STILL retimed jd 13->12, scoring 11->10, screening 10->9, assignments 10->9, gates 10->9 (archetypes stays 10); first-ness case would fail on the old values. `grep 'at([0-9]' scenes/*/*.tsx` = 0 and chapters.test.ts no longer reads any scene TSX by name (only the citation scan, which now also covers the six data.ts). tsc whole-tree exit 2 is foreign only (kpi-sim/ untracked copy, sibling analyze/job-workspace-state work); 0 errors under insights/about. Full test:unit exit 1 = 5 BROKEN files, all a sibling's in-flight tenancy/job_workspace_state work (job-workspace-state-tenancy, tenancy-coverage, route-tenancy-coverage, workspaces-route) + 1 FLAKE python-runner-concurrency; 0 failures under insights/about (73/73). test:perf: my share is within the raised 1377/8741; the remaining app/page.tsx overage (1378 / 8751) is sibling work landed or in flight after base, plus the known llm-config/job-ingest lines. Slot B (transport) edits useSceneClock/clock/shared.tsx/AboutTab and the same README Clock-contract paragraph: expect a small textual merge there; B can take named beats from sceneAt/STATUS_BEATS.
